channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Straughn gets first win of season against Houston Academy
item.description: Straughn's young Tigers earn first win of 2026, topping Houston Academy 12-7 behind key performances from Eli Grissett and Tate Watson in the midst of a challenging early schedule.

item.title: AHS Soccer returns from Wiregrass Cup as Champions
item.description: Andalusia varsity soccer swept the Wiregrass Cup 3-0, outscoring foes 15-2 as standouts Cobb Stewart, Gabriel Miller and Logan Reeves powered a turnaround.

item.title: Peddlers’ Market to host Hello Spring
item.description: Hello Spring set for April 18, 10 a.m.–2 p.m., at Peddlers’ Market in Red Level, with magician BIMO, Carlie’s Petting Zoo, live music from Chris Eiland and free admission.

item.title: CCSO publicizes 2025 statistics
item.description: Covington County Sheriff’s Office releases 2025 report detailing 11,563 calls for service, 4,765 jail bookings, 4,186 training hours, and school and community outreach.

item.title: CCWJC honors recent graduates
item.description: Seven women graduate from Covington Christian Women’s Job Corps after mentoring, life skills and GED prep, as the ministry recruits support for its April 2026 session.

item.title: Andalusia Ballet’s dancers shine in ‘Sleeping Beauty’
item.description: Andalusia Ballet’s “Sleeping Beauty” dazzles at the Dixon Center, with seniors Mia Baumgartner and Anna Williams leading a skilled cast in Tchaikovsky’s classic ballet.

item.title: COOKIES FOR A CAUSE
item.description: Meredith’s Miracles’ 20th Cookies with Characters raised a record estimated $115,000, helping fund travel and non-medical costs for hundreds of children in south Alabama.

item.title: Wednesday | March 4, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our March 4, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.

item.title: Jail Report from February 27 to March 2
item.description: Local jail bookings from Feb. 27–March 2 include charges ranging from failure to appear and probation violations to drug, domestic violence and harassment offenses.

item.title: Doug Parrish Obituary
item.description: Obituary: Doug Parrish of Alabama, born in Andalusia and later of Dothan, is remembered as a devoted servant to church, family and neighbors, with services in Dothan and Andalusia.
